# Miro — Miro Startup Program

A one-time Miro account credit: $1,000 for startups connected to a Miro Startup Program partner, or $500 for individual startups applying directly. One credit per startup.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [📋 Productivity & Ops](../categories/productivity.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Maximum** | $1,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Expiry** | Your credit should be activated within 6 months. |
| **When it ends** | Credit is applied against a plan purchase; once the $1,000 or $500 limit is reached the card on file begins to be charged. |

### Tiers

Each tier has its own eligibility. A headline figure is usually the top tier, not
what a typical applicant receives.

| Tier | Amount | The vendor's wording | Gate |
|---|---|---|---|
| Partner-connected startup | $1,000 | Startups working with one of our global Miro Startup Program partners are eligible for a $1,000 credit. | A partner code is required |
| Individual startup | $500 | Individual startups are eligible for a $500 credit. We accept individual startups on a case-by-case basis. | No partner needed |

### Not covered

- Service providers (for example consulting)
- Companies owned by a parent corporation (partner-connected tier)

> **Stacking:** One startup is eligible for one credit. Terms state the offer "cannot be combined with volume discounts or other product/order level promotions, discounts or offers" and changing plan later forfeits the promotion.

**Stages named by the vendor:** pre-seed, seed, series-a

### Where it is available

**The vendor publishes no geographic restriction.** That is not the same as
confirming it is available where you are — check their terms before applying.

### Notes

Gates differ by tier, so top-level funding and headcount fields are left null/unknown rather than flattened. The fewer-than-30-employees cap applies ONLY to the partner-connected ($1,000) tier. The funding requirement ("be funded, verified via Crunchbase") applies ONLY to the individual ($500) tier — a bootstrapped startup with no partner connection does not meet the published individual-tier criteria. new_customer_only is true per the T&Cs: "Not currently an Admin and/or member of an active, expired, or trial paid subscription". Miro also warns applicants to remain on the Free plan while waiting, as signing up for a trial may affect eligibility. Separately, the help article notes a 25% Enterprise Plan discount for venture-backed startups already paying, applied for at https://miro.com/startups/scale-offer-vc/ — a different offer, not recorded here. Independently re-audited: a second reviewer opened the vendor page and checked the quote, amount and source.
